summaries.zh: Colibri 是一个轻量级推理引擎，旨在让用户在现有硬件上运行前沿的混合专家模型。该项目采用纯 C 语言编写，零外部依赖，支持从磁盘流式加载专家模块，实现了“小引擎运行大模型”。目前该项目在 GitHub 上已获得超过 2.8 万星标，广受关注。
summaries.en: "JustVugg/colibri" is a popular open-source project written in pure C designed to run frontier Mixture of Experts (MoE) models on existing hardware. The engine features zero dependencies and streams experts directly from disk, enabling the execution of immense models with a tiny footprint. With over 28,000 stars and 3,000 forks, the repository highlights a lightweight, efficient solution for running advanced AI models without requiring specialized infrastructure.
